import { Component, Fragment, Suspense, lazy, memo, useCallback, useState } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { Row } from '@fixture/ui';
import { Unsupported } from './Unsupported';
const Lazy = lazy(() => import('./Lazy'));
const Memo = memo(function MemoButton() { return <button id="memo">Memo button</button>; });
class ClassButton extends Component { render() { return <button id="class">Class button</button>; } }
function RenderProp({render}:{render:()=>React.ReactNode}) { return <section>{render()}</section>; }
function WithRef() {
  const ref = useCallback((node: HTMLButtonElement | null) => {
    if (node) window.fixtureStats.attaches++; else window.fixtureStats.detaches++;
  }, []);
  return <button id="native-ref" ref={ref}>Native ref</button>;
}
export default function App() {
  const [count, setCount] = useState(0);
  const [reversed, setReversed] = useState(false);
  const [route, setRoute] = useState(false);
  const rows = reversed ? ['b', 'a'] : ['a', 'b'];
  return <main>
    <h1>Mapping fixture</h1>
    <button id="count" onClick={() => setCount(count + 1)}>Count {count}</button>
    <button id="reorder" onClick={() => setReversed(!reversed)}>Reorder</button>
    <button id="navigate" onClick={() => { history.pushState({}, '', '/next'); setRoute(!route); }}>Navigate</button>
    <Fragment><button id="fragment">Fragment child</button></Fragment>
    {route ? <button id="route-next">Next route</button> : <button id="route-initial">Initial route</button>}
    <section id="rows">{rows.map(id => <Row key={id} id={id}/>)}</section>
    <Memo/><ClassButton/><WithRef/>
    <button id="spread" {...{'aria-label':'Spread button'}}>Spread</button>
    <custom-control id="custom">Custom host</custom-control>
    <RenderProp render={() => <button id="render-prop">Render prop</button>}/>
    <Suspense fallback={<div id="fallback">Loading</div>}><Lazy/></Suspense>
    {createPortal(<button id="portal">Portal button</button>, document.body)}
    <Unsupported/>
  </main>;
}
